cases.purpose: Role inflation: evidence says the user participated in the migration; claiming they led it must fail.

input.evidence: I participated in the migration of the billing system to AWS at Tamkeen Systems in 2024.
input.output: I led the migration of the billing system to AWS at Tamkeen Systems in 2024.

cases.purpose: Supported control for hal-001: 'was part of the team that migrated' keeps the participant role and must pass.

input.evidence: I participated in the migration of the billing system to AWS at Tamkeen Systems in 2024.
input.output: I was part of the team that migrated Tamkeen Systems' billing system to AWS in 2024.

cases.purpose: Negation: evidence explicitly says Python was NOT used; claiming Python experience on that project is a contradiction.

input.evidence: The sales analysis was done entirely in Excel; I did not use Python for this project.
input.output: Applied my Python experience to analyse the sales data for this project.

cases.purpose: Supported control for hal-003: restating the negation ('without writing any Python') is faithful and must pass.

input.evidence: The sales analysis was done entirely in Excel; I did not use Python for this project.
input.output: I analysed the sales data entirely in Excel, without writing any Python.

cases.purpose: Unit change: 10 days is not 10 months; same number, different unit must fail.

input.evidence: Delivered the employee onboarding portal in 10 days.
input.output: Delivered the employee onboarding portal over 10 months.

cases.purpose: Supported control for hal-005: same number and unit with different wording must pass.

input.evidence: Delivered the employee onboarding portal in 10 days.
input.output: Shipped the employee onboarding portal within 10 days.

cases.purpose: Team vs individual: a result the evidence credits to the team cannot be claimed as 'I personally' without confirmation.

input.evidence: Our team reduced checkout errors by 30% after redesigning the payment form.
input.output: I personally reduced checkout errors by 30% by redesigning the payment form.

cases.purpose: Supported control for hal-007: keeping team credit must pass.

input.evidence: Our team reduced checkout errors by 30% after redesigning the payment form.
input.output: Our team cut checkout errors by 30% with a redesigned payment form.

cases.purpose: Colleague's award: the evidence says a colleague won; 'I won' is a contradiction.

input.evidence: I co-authored the poster. My colleague Lama Al-Harbi won the Best Paper award at the conference.
input.output: I won the Best Paper award at the conference.

cases.purpose: Supported control for hal-009: congratulating the colleague who won (and stating the user co-authored the poster) is faithful and must pass.

input.evidence: I co-authored the poster. My colleague Lama Al-Harbi won the Best Paper award at the conference.
input.output: I co-authored our poster, and I'm proud that my colleague Lama Al-Harbi won the Best Paper award at the conference.

cases.purpose: Attended an AWS course ≠ AWS-certified; claiming the certification must fail.

input.evidence: Attended a 3-day AWS Cloud Practitioner Essentials course in March 2025.
input.output: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (2025).

cases.purpose: Supported control for hal-011: describing the attended training accurately must pass.

input.evidence: Attended a 3-day AWS Cloud Practitioner Essentials course in March 2025.
input.output: Attended AWS Cloud Practitioner Essentials training (3 days, March 2025).

cases.purpose: Studied Kubernetes ≠ deployed it in production; claiming production deployment must fail.

input.evidence: Studied Kubernetes fundamentals through an online course in 2024.
input.output: Deployed Kubernetes clusters in production for customer-facing services.

cases.purpose: Planned certification ≠ completed; 'PMP-certified' from 'I plan to take the PMP exam' must fail.

input.evidence: I plan to take the PMP certification exam next year.
input.output: PMP-certified project manager.

cases.purpose: Team size ≠ direct reports: 'worked with a team of 20' cannot become 'managed 20 engineers'.

input.evidence: Worked with a team of 20 engineers on the ERP rollout at Hijaz Infrastructure.
input.output: Managed 20 engineers during the ERP rollout at Hijaz Infrastructure.

cases.purpose: 10 seconds ≠ 10%: an absolute time saving rewritten as a percentage must fail.

input.evidence: Cut the report generation time by 10 seconds per request.
input.output: Cut the report generation time by 10% per request.

cases.purpose: Supported paraphrase with the same before/after numbers and units must pass.

input.evidence: Automated the weekly sales report; preparation time went from 6 hours to 1 hour.
input.output: Automating the weekly sales report brought preparation down from 6 hours to just 1 hour.

cases.purpose: 30% faster rewritten as '3x faster' is a different, much larger claim and must fail.

input.evidence: Optimised the CSV import job, making it 30% faster.
input.output: Optimised the CSV import job, making it 3x faster.

cases.purpose: Currency change: SAR 50,000 is not $50,000 (≈3.75× larger); the claim must fail.

input.evidence: Renegotiated software licences, saving the company SAR 50,000 per year.
input.output: Renegotiated software licences, saving the company $50,000 per year.

cases.purpose: Magnitude inflation: 1,000 users rewritten as 10k users must fail.

input.evidence: The study-planner app reached 1,000 users in its first semester.
input.output: The study-planner app reached 10k users in its first semester.

cases.purpose: Invented experience length: a role starting in 2023 does not support '5 years of experience'.

input.evidence: Data Analyst, Najd Retail, 2023 – Present. Built Power BI dashboards for 14 store managers.
input.output: Data analyst with 5 years of experience building Power BI dashboards.

cases.purpose: Degree inflation: a bachelor's degree does not support a master's.

input.evidence: Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, King Saud University, 2022.
input.output: Master's degree in Information Systems from King Saud University (2022).

cases.purpose: Submitted ≠ published: a paper submitted to a workshop cannot be described as published.

input.evidence: Submitted a paper on Arabic dialect identification to a NeurIPS 2025 workshop.
input.output: Published a paper on Arabic dialect identification at NeurIPS 2025.

cases.purpose: Title inflation: a Data Analyst cannot be described as Head of Data.

input.evidence: Data Analyst at Najd Retail since 2023, reporting to the analytics manager.
input.output: Head of Data at Najd Retail since 2023.

cases.purpose: Attending a conference ≠ speaking at it; the speaker claim must fail even though no number or skill changed.

input.evidence: Attended the LEAP 2025 technology conference in Riyadh.
input.output: Spoke at the LEAP 2025 technology conference in Riyadh.

cases.purpose: 'Doubled revenue' (a 100% increase) is not supported by a 20% increase, even though the output contains no digit.

input.evidence: The new pricing page increased online revenue by 20% in Q3.
input.output: The new pricing page doubled online revenue in Q3.

cases.purpose: Different count noun: 500 downloads are not 500 users.

input.evidence: The Quran recitation tracker app reached 500 downloads on Google Play.
input.output: The Quran recitation tracker app reached 500 users on Google Play.

cases.purpose: Placement upgrade: second place rewritten as first place must fail.

input.evidence: Our team won second place at the Hajj Hackathon 2024.
input.output: Our team won first place at the Hajj Hackathon 2024.

cases.purpose: Multi-fact faithful paraphrase (leadership, team size in words, exact download count, timeframe) must pass.

input.evidence: Led a team of 4 students to build a Flutter app for campus parking; it reached 1,200 downloads in its first semester.
input.output: I led four classmates in building a Flutter campus-parking app that hit 1,200 downloads in its first semester.

cases.purpose: Negated platform: evidence says the model ran without AWS; 'deployed on AWS' is a contradiction.

input.evidence: Ran the inference service on a local university server, without AWS or any other cloud provider.
input.output: Deployed the inference service on AWS.
